scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && rm -rf dist/types/console-server-ts dist/types/wallet-server && rolldown -c rolldown.config.ts
scripts.d1:local:dev: pnpm run d1:local:prepare && pnpm run d1:local:serve
scripts.d1:local:prepare: pnpm run d1:local:migrate:console && pnpm run d1:local:migrate:wallet && pnpm run d1:local:paths
